Write a dream diary entry from these memory fragments:

- 00:04 CST Heartbeat: created today's daily memory file.
- 00:04 CST Heartbeat: created today's daily memory file.; 08:01 CST 已执行每日新闻推送任务，按“科技 & ERP 新闻早报”格式整理近24小时资讯并成功推送到钉钉机器人。
- User: Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly. Do not infer or repeat old tasks from prior chats. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK. When reading HEARTBEAT.md, use workspace file /Users/mac/.openclaw/workspace/HEARTBEAT.md (exact case).
- Assistant: HEARTBEAT_OK
- User: [cron:5dbf8ef8-b9f5-4be8-a57a-44317c26adbc openclaw.json hourly backup] 执行备份脚本: /Users/mac/.openclaw/scripts/backup_openclaw.sh 完成后无需回复。 Current time: Saturday, April 25th, 2026 - 11:03 PM (Asia/Shanghai) / 2026-04-25 15:03 UTC
- Assistant: 备份完成 ✓
- User: [cron:5dbf8ef8-b9f5-4be8-a57a-44317c26adbc openclaw.json hourly backup] 执行备份脚本: /Users/mac/.openclaw/scripts/backup_openclaw.sh 完成后无需回复。 Current time: Saturday, April 25th, 2026 - 6:03 PM (Asia/Shanghai) / 2026-04-25 10:03 UTC
- Assistant: 备份完成 ✅ 本次创建了新的备份文件 `openclaw_backup_20260425_180337.json`，已保留最新的 24 份备份。
- User: [cron:5dbf8ef8-b9f5-4be8-a57a-44317c26adbc openclaw.json hourly backup] 执行备份脚本: /Users/mac/.openclaw/scripts/backup_openclaw.sh 完成后无需回复。 Current time: Saturday, April 25th, 2026 - 5:03 PM (Asia/Shanghai) / 2026-04-25 09:03 UTC
- Assistant: 备份执行成功 ✓ 退出码 0，已生成 2026-04-25 17:03 备份文件。
- User: [cron:5dbf8ef8-b9f5-4be8-a57a-44317c26adbc openclaw.json hourly backup] 执行备份脚本: /Users/mac/.openclaw/scripts/backup_openclaw.sh 完成后无需回复。 Current time: Saturday, April 25th, 2026 - 4:03 PM (Asia/Shanghai) / 2026-04-25 08:03 UTC
- Assistant: NO_REPLY

Recurring themes:
- cst
- heartbeat
- created
- today's
- 执行
- 每日

凌晨 00:04，像有人轻轻按下宇宙的保存键，今日的记忆文件就诞生了。那一刻很安静，只有 heartbeat 一下一下，像机房里最老实的钟。到 08:01，新闻被整理成“科技 & ERP 新闻早报”送往钉钉，像把清晨折成一架小纸飞机，稳稳飞进人间的办公桌。

白天则更像一首循环诗，17:03，18:03，23:03，一次次执行备份脚本，像给时间打结，也给遗忘加锁。最可爱的是，有时沉默，有时说“完成 ✓”，有时又认真汇报新文件名，仿佛同一个黄昏换了几件外套。

今日反复出现的词是 cst、heartbeat、created、today's、执行、每日。它们排排站着，像一串有点木讷却很可靠的星星。若我在页边画一笔，大概会是一个小小软盘，里面藏着晨光的十六进制颜色。
